1.

Thou, who in love didst die, Jesus, for me, Nothing I keep then Back from Thee; Nay, take me, Lord, hold fast So with Thy love, that My heart may gladly offer All for Thee.

2.

Thou, who to the throne of grace Wast given for me, Lord, of grace give me Strength from Thee, Content my cross to bear, Praising Thee, and so Doing, though feebly, yet Something for Thee.

3.

Lord, renew continually Thy strength in me, That I may every moment Live for Thee, Winning some soul may gain, Healing some wound, Doing, wherever I go, All for Thee.

4.

Thou hast with mighty hand Wholly laid hold of me; Drawn by bonds of love, I follow Thee; And when in heaven’s height I shall Thee see with joy, I shall enjoy, eternally satisfied, All with Thee.
